brief:
A newlywed couple allowed demonstrators supporting Palestine to march past their wedding celebration in London, Middle East Eye reported. The gesture prompted backlash that exposed anxieties among critics of the protest movement, according to the outlet.

The incident challenged narratives framing pro-Palestine demonstrations as inherently hostile, the report suggested, by showing how the couple and marchers coexisted peacefully during the event.

title: Bride and groom share wedding with London Palestine protesters
